Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never found fault with food (served to him). If he liked anything, he ate it and if he did not like it he left it
This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters
A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of A'mash

Abu Huraira reported:I never saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finding fault with food (served to him) ; if he liked it he ate it, and if did not like it he kept silent. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through a different chain of transmitters
